sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent run of five consecutive wins, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Alsager arrive in poor form with just one win in their last six and occupy the bottom half of the division, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their commanding position at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tricky away trip to Dawley Town, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in what could be a closely contested fixture between two sides in the upper half. Wolverhampton Casuals, also competing near the top, travel to Wednesfield Community in a division-wide encounter. Bilston Town welcome Foley Meir in a mid-table clash, and Barnton host Shawbury United—the latter's recent collapse of five consecutive defeats makes them heavy underdogs. Market Drayton Town travel to face New Mills, both teams struggling with inconsistency, while Cheadle Heath Nomads' poor run continues as they visit Telford Town in a basement-battle fixture. Crewe host Allscott Heath, and Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town, whose lack of wins this season leaves them as heavy underdogs across the division's remaining matchups.
